draft.title: Describing a distribution
card: A distribution is how something is spread across space. Geographers use it to describe where things are found.
close together in groups, with large gaps between groups. Scattered means spread out with no clear pattern.
arranged along a line, such as along a river or road. Even means spaced about the same distance apart.
A full description also says where the thing is most common and where it is least common.
draft.remember: Describe the pattern, then say where there is most and least.

a.q: Farms in a region lie in a long row beside a river, with few farms elsewhere. How is this distribution best described?
a.why: The farms follow a line beside the river, so the pattern is linear. Clustered is tempting because the farms are close together, but clustered means grouped in patches, not stretched along a line.
a.clue: Look at the shape the farms make.

b.q: A map shows most of a state's schools in one large city, with only a few spread across the rest of the state. What should a full description say?
opts: Clustered in the city, and least common elsewhere
Scattered everywhere, and most common in the city
Even across the state, and least common in the city
Linear across the state, and most common elsewhere
b.why: Most schools are grouped in the city, so the pattern is clustered, and few are found elsewhere. Scattered is tempting because a few schools are spread out, but the main pattern is a large group in one place.
b.clue: Name the pattern, then say where there is most and least.

b.best: Clustered in the city, and least common elsewhere
